scope: Propagate and validate measured profiles in the existing eight-member optimization-panel freezer; document a separate prospective six-member family without implementing it.
python_discipline: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 and python -B; PYTHONPATH=src selects this isolated checkout.

red.selection: measured_profile or malformed_profile or changed_measurement_binding or cli_freezes
red.observed_failure: Measured actual-freezer and CLI tests reached panel-profile equality and refused omitted registration/recipe profiles. Explicit null was incorrectly accepted.
red.fixture_preparation: Before the recorded RED run, synchronize synthetic learning profile bindings and replace a non-serializable NaN fixture with a serializable out-of-range reliability value. These are test-fixture corrections, not runtime failures.

guarantees_checked: Actual freeze entry and CLI preserve the exact registered profile across all supported prefix sizes.
Profile-free registration and recipe field sets remain unchanged.
Null and malformed profiles refuse before any archive panel write.
Protocol, registration or recipe omission, conflict or null replacement refuses definition validation.
Registration hashing includes the profile; persisted archive output equals the returned definition.
Caller profile mutation does not change either output, and registration and recipe hold independent copies.
Existing eight-member, spent-allocation, custody, runtime and READ-authority refusals remain intact.
handoff: Root reviews and serially integrates the patch. Round9 still requires a separately registered six-member evaluation design and explicit resolution of the owner223/227 mismatch.
